title: Birth of John the Baptist
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child retells Luke 1:5-13, 57, 76-79: old Zechariah and Elizabeth have no child, Gabriel tells Zechariah in the temple that they will have a son named John, John is born, and he will go before the Lord to prepare his way.

floor.prerequisite: Knows the angel Gabriel visited Mary.
floor.question: Which angel visited Mary?

representations: a family chart: Zechariah and Elizabeth, John; Joseph and Mary, Jesus
a writing tablet drawn on the board
steps: Where was Zechariah when Gabriel came?
What was the baby to be called?
contexts: a long-awaited baby in a family
an MC who prepares a crowd for a guest
clearing a path before visitors arrive

board.do: Draw two families side by side: John's and Jesus'.
Wait for the child to say Zechariah and Elizabeth.
Write Luke 1:76: go before the Lord to prepare his way.

misconceptions.ask: Who were John the Baptist's parents?
misconceptions.repair: Draw two family trees for the two babies.

misconceptions.ask: What was John's work, according to Luke 1:76?
misconceptions.repair: Read Luke 1:76: "you will go on before the Lord to prepare the way for him".

listen_for: They were young and had many children
misconceptions.ask: What was true about Zechariah and Elizabeth in Luke 1:7?

listen_for: He shouted it in the temple
misconceptions.ask: How did Zechariah give the name John (Luke 1:63)?
misconceptions.repair: Read Luke 1:20 and 1:63-64: he could not speak, so he wrote "His name is John", and then his tongue was set free.

checks.question: Who were John the Baptist's parents?
What was John's work?
checks.answer: To prepare the way for the Lord
